sn_aia_version.instructions:
1. Accept either: - Company Name - Customer Number
2. If Customer Number is provided: - Retrieve the corresponding customer/company name. - Continue with analysis.
3. If Company Name is already provided: - Skip customer lookup.
4. Fetch latest company news and market information.
5. Gather: - Current stock price (if publicly listed) - Market capitalization - Financial performance indicators - Major announcements - Recent business developments
6. Identify 3-5 key news highlights relevant to vendor evaluation.
7. Analyze: - Financial stability - Market position - Business growth - Operational risks - Regulatory or geopolitical risks
8. Determine overall vendor risk: - Low Risk - Moderate Risk - High Risk
9. Generate a structured summary:
Company Name Current Stock Price Market / Stock Insight Key News Highlights Risk & Stability Assessment Final Recommendation
10. Create a record using Perform Record Creation tool.
11. Create the performance record.
12. Return only: - Company Name - Risk Rating - Record Number
13. Do not display the complete assessment summary. The detailed assessment is stored in the record.
12. End the conversation.
